conclusion: In this paper, we introduce Qwen-Image, an image generation foundation model within the Qwen series, achieving major advancements in both complex text rendering and precise image editing. By constructing a comprehensive data pipeline and adopting a progressive curriculum learning strategy, Qwen-Image substantially improves its capability to render intricate text within generated images. Moreover, our improved multi-task training paradigm and dual-encoding mechanism significantly enhance the consistency and quality of image editing, effectively improving both semantic coherence and visual fidelity. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks consistently demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of Qwen-Image across a wide range of image generation and editing tasks.
